author: Bobby Grayson
description: Scratch file combo.ex (Worker raw loop with :job/{:set,k} when k>0/:crash/:stop; Sup GenServer with init(n) trap_exit block, handle_info :start spawn_link + EXIT, handle_cast :restart on nil-child state and {:kick,k} when k>n). Output ordering per module: worker arms, worker defer clause; sup .restart, .kick, crash clause for .restart, then .start and .EXIT info clauses; global catch-all kept because Sup is not covered. The pre-existing 'clause 7 guard has no fallthrough' warning is the info-clause EXIT pid-narrowing guard, as at base. No committed example exercises guarded defer or spawn_monitor; adding one would give these paths a regression test.
title: Combined translator paths verified on a scratch module (not committed): a raw loop with a guarded arm renders 'me, _, .worker n, m@(.set k) => if k > 0 then .. else (.worker n, [.send me m])' and a defer clause last; a GenServer in the same file gets its .restart crash clause between cast and info clauses and a failed cast guard renders (state, [.exit .error]); spawn_link(Worker, :run, [0]) renders .spawnLink (.worker 0)
